dict.txt.source_scope: 62k runtime word list; the pinned upstream README does not provide per-entry provenance for dict.txt

packages.name: pythainlp
packages.excluded_unused_corpus_assets: All non-Python corpus files except words_th.txt and corpus_license.md

publication_gate: Inspect the exact FastThaiG2P wheel member list and SHA-256.
Resolve the merged dict.txt/ipa.json provenance or produce a reproducible source-separated replacement.
Map each fallback file to its exact TLTK source and verify BSD-3-Clause terms and attribution.
Retain Pyodide MPL-2.0, PyThaiNLP Apache-2.0 and CC0 corpus notices, tzdata notice, FastThaiG2P Apache-2.0 and applicable TLTK BSD-3 notices.
Set redistribution_approved to true only after the complete manifest is evidence-backed.
notes: The browser compatibility and parity tests may use ephemeral CI wheels; this does not grant public redistribution permission.
GitHub Pages deployment must remain gated while redistribution_approved is false.
No linguistic accuracy or independent IPA gold claim follows from this manifest.
